Part of the [pycyxwiz API reference](index.md), pycyxwiz 0.2.0: each name with the signature and description the module itself reports. Types are shown without the `pycyxwiz.` prefix; `Sequence[int]` is any list or tuple of integers.

## Functions

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `create_lr_warmup(optimizer_type: OptimizerType, learning_rate: float = 0.001, warmup_steps: int = 1000, warmup_type: WarmupType = WarmupType.Linear) -> LRWarmup` | Create an optimizer with learning rate warmup |
| `create_optimizer(type: OptimizerType, learning_rate: float = 0.001) -> Optimizer` | Create an optimizer instance |

## Enumerations

- `OptimizerType`: `SGD`, `Adam`, `AdamW`, `RMSprop`, `AdaGrad`, `NAdam`, `Adadelta`, `LAMB`
- `WarmupType`: `None_`, `Linear`, `Cosine`

### `LRWarmup`

Learning rate warmup wrapper. Use create_lr_warmup() to create instances.

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `LRWarmup(/, *args, **kwargs)` |  |
| `get_current_lr(self: LRWarmup) -> float` | Get current learning rate (after warmup adjustment) |
| `get_warmup_progress(self: LRWarmup) -> float` | Get warmup progress (0.0 to 1.0) |
| `is_warmup_complete(self: LRWarmup) -> bool` | Check if warmup phase is complete |
| `step(self: LRWarmup, parameters: Mapping[str, Tensor], gradients: Mapping[str, Tensor]) -> None` | Perform optimizer step with warmup-adjusted learning rate |
| `zero_grad(self: LRWarmup) -> None` | Clear optimizer state |
